lines.en: Sss, leap forward.

lines.zh: 双生的影子在夜色中交错。
lines.en: Shadows intertwine in the night.
Rumble low, move fast.
Swing claws, never let go.
Sss, footsteps grow closer.
Shadows flicker, close in.

lines.zh: 身形忽大忽小，无声移动。
lines.en: Shape shift, move silent.

lines.zh: 发出无声的嘶嘶声，逼近。
lines.en: Sss, inch closer.

lines.zh: 利爪划破夜色，快速掠过。
lines.en: Claws slice through the night.

lines.zh: 双生的影子合二为一，紧逼。
lines.en: Shadows merge, press on.

lines.zh: 两具身形一前一后交替。
lines.en: Two shapes trade places, front and back.
One walks while the other climbs the wall.
Stare, wary of danger.
Wait, patient for prey.
Watch, seek prey.
Wait, remain still.

lines.zh: 静静地注视着每一个动作。
lines.en: Stare intently at each move.

lines.zh: 静静等待时机，突然袭击。
lines.en: Wait, strike suddenly.

lines.zh: 静静地等待，然后突然袭击。
lines.en: Wait, then strike.
Stand still, watch keenly.
Wait, then act.
Watch, then pounce.

lines.zh: 察觉到你，眼中闪过凶光。
lines.en: Eye glint with menace.

lines.zh: 我这两副身子，随时换着来。
lines.en: My two bodies swap without warning.
Eye on you, ready to strike.

lines.zh: 注意到你，眼神充满敌意。
lines.en: Notice you, eyes filled with malice.

lines.zh: 盯着你看，准备发动攻击。
lines.en: Stare at you, ready to attack.
Lock eyes, prepare to pounce.
Notice you, eyes dangerous.
Eye on you, wait for chance.
Eye on you, ready to strike.
Eye on you, prepare to attack.

lines.zh: 双子发出微弱的呜咽声
lines.en: The Twins give a weak whimper.

lines.zh: 其中一只双子痛苦地嘶吼
lines.en: One of the Twins howls in pain.

lines.zh: 双子互相安慰，声音微弱
lines.en: The Twins comfort each other weakly.
The Twins groan, their voices hoarse.
The Twins wheeze painfully.
The Twins whisper in agony.
The Twins cry out in pain.
The Twins moan in agony.

lines.zh: 双子的声音中充满了痛苦
lines.en: The Twins' voice is full of pain.

lines.zh: 双子痛苦地呻吟着倒地
lines.en: The Twins groan and fall to the ground in pain.
Feel the power of the Twins!

lines.zh: 小心，我的箭比你想象的更致命。
lines.en: Watch out, my arrows are deadlier than you think.
Think you can avoid me?
Taste my arrows!
My power comes from the Nightmare.

lines.zh: 你是第一个非玩家生物。
lines.en: You're the first non-player to fall.
There's no mercy in Twins' battles.
My forms will surprise you.
You can't escape my arrows.
The power of Twins transcends dreams.

lines.zh: 我们两个，你只挡住一个。
lines.en: There are two of us; you block only one.
Stay back, it's dangerous.
Only one of us can live.
You dare block my path?
The Twins never retreat.
Your existence angers me.

lines.zh: 弓弦已经拉满，你听见了吗。
lines.en: The bowstring is drawn; do you hear it?
You're unlucky to meet me.
Move, and you'll regret it.
You blocked my exit.

lines.zh: 找到我的伴侣，我们一同毁灭。
lines.en: Find my mate, and we'll destroy together.
Our powers combined.
Stay away from my mate.

lines.zh: 与我的伴侣战斗，你会输。
lines.en: Battle my mate, and you'll lose.
She's mine, you can't take her.

lines.zh: 我的伴侣，我最强大的武器。
lines.en: My mate, my strongest weapon.

lines.zh: 我们的力量让梦魇颤栗。
lines.en: Our power shakes the Nightmare.

lines.zh: 你别想破坏我们的和平。
lines.en: You won't break our peace.
Two bodies, one arrow.
You can't stop us.

lines.zh: 我蹲下，又换成近身的姿态。
lines.en: I crouch, switching to a close-range stance.
Twins are hungry, seeking food!
I'll shift form and shoot again.

lines.zh: 此地不适合，找其他地方。
lines.en: Not suitable here, find elsewhere.
Got the prey!
This food is good.

lines.zh: 栖息在黑暗中，等待猎物。
lines.en: Rest in darkness, await prey.
My quiver still holds plenty of arrows.

lines.zh: 快速攻击，不能浪费机会。
lines.en: Quick attack, don’t waste the chance.
Remote shot, target the prey.
Prey is below.

lines.zh: 箭尖和爪尖，一起对准你。
lines.en: Arrow tip and claw point at you together.

lines.zh: 梦魇二层，我的弓已经拉满。
lines.en: Nightmare's second floor - my bow is already drawn.

lines.zh: 我切成两张脸，你打哪一张？
lines.en: I split into two faces; which will you hit?

lines.zh: 你一转身，我们就换形态。
lines.en: Turn your back and we change form.
Prey is about to be caught.
Lock, aim, kill.
Prey has no where to run.
Lock, switch form, attack.
Target locked, rapid shot.
Nightmare layer two has a visitor.
The bowstring sounds before it arrives.

lines.zh: 两双眼睛从不同方向看你。
lines.en: Two sets of eyes watch from different sides.

lines.zh: 它换了个形态，弓拉满了。
lines.en: It changes form. The bow draws full.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸在这儿太吵了。
lines.en: Your breathing is too loud down here.

lines.zh: 双子不需要同伴也能包夹。
lines.en: The twins can flank you alone.
Target, aim!
Aim, lock!
Target, kill!
Target locked, don’t miss!

lines.zh: 半张弓，半只爪，同时抬起。
lines.en: Half bow, half claw, lifted as one.
Target, aim and shoot!
Lock, aim, hit!
Target, kill with a shot!
Aim, lock, shoot.
Target locked, remote shot.

lines.zh: 一支箭钉在你脚前的石缝。
lines.en: An arrow bites the stone at your feet.

lines.zh: 它后退半步，是拉弓的姿势。
lines.en: It steps back into a drawing stance.
It reads which way you'll dodge.
The arrowhead slides with you.
It drops the bow and bares its claws.

lines.zh: 另一个从天花板倒挂下来。
lines.en: The other hangs down from the ceiling.

lines.zh: 两者一前一后，没有死角。
lines.en: One ahead, one behind. No blind spot.
The arrow stays nocked and doesn't fly.

lines.zh: 它盯着你的膝盖，先削弱。
lines.en: It watches your knees. Cripple first.

lines.zh: 两个身影同时抬起了头。
lines.en: Both shapes lift their heads at once.
A sharp howl pierces the night.

lines.zh: 双子冲向敌人，利爪划破空气。
lines.en: The twins charge, claws slicing through the air.

lines.zh: 它们的利齿在月光下闪烁。
lines.en: Their sharp teeth glint in the moonlight.

lines.zh: 双子一跃而起，狠狠一击。
lines.en: The twins leap, delivering a hard strike.

lines.zh: 你感觉到了它们的寒意。
lines.en: You feel their chill.

lines.zh: 它们的战斗姿态让人不寒而栗。
lines.en: Their fighting stance is terrifying.

lines.zh: 双子的攻击令人防不胜防。
lines.en: The twins' attacks are hard to evade.

lines.zh: 它们的每一次打击都充满恶意。
lines.en: Every strike they make is malicious.

lines.zh: 双子的爪子在你身上撕开一道伤口。
lines.en: Their claws tear a wound in you.

lines.zh: 它们在你身上留下深深的伤痕。
lines.en: They leave deep marks on you
A claw tears your sleeve open!
It lunges at your leg from the side!
An arrow grazes your ear!

lines.zh: 另一只在背后推了你一把！
lines.en: The other shoves you from behind!
Claws hook into your leggings!
It leaps onto your shoulder and rips down!
An arrow pins your shield!

lines.zh: 两只同时咬住你的手臂！
lines.en: Both bite your arm at once!

lines.zh: 梦魇之力灌进这道伤口！
lines.en: Nightmare force pours into the wound!

lines.zh: 它撞你的膝盖，想让你跪！
lines.en: It strikes your knee to bring you down!
They emerge slowly from the darkness.

lines.zh: 双子的影子在梦魇的地面移动。
lines.en: The twins' shadows move across the nightmare ground.

lines.zh: 在阴影中，它们缓缓显形。
lines.en: They slowly materialize in the shadows.

lines.zh: 它们仿佛来自另一个世界。
lines.en: They seem to come from another world.

lines.zh: 双子如同噩梦一般出现。
lines.en: The twins appear like nightmares.

lines.zh: 梦魇的第二层，它们现身。
lines.en: They appear in the second layer of nightmare.
They slowly rise from the ground.

lines.zh: 双子在黑暗中渐渐显现。
lines.en: The twins gradually appear in the darkness.

lines.zh: 它们的身影逐渐变得清晰。
lines.en: Their forms become clearer.

lines.zh: 双子从阴影中慢慢走出。
lines.en: The twins slowly step out of the shadows

lines.zh: 梦魇第二层的空气裂了缝。
lines.en: A seam splits the air of nightmare layer two.

lines.zh: 黑暗中走出来两个一样的影子。
lines.en: Two identical shadows step out of the dark.

lines.zh: 双子的皮肤被火焰灼伤
lines.en: The Twins' skin is scorched by fire.
The Twins fall from a great height.
The Twins drown in the water.
The Twins are hit by shrapnel.
The Twins are struck by an arrow.
The Twins are hit by magic.
The Twins are starved and weak.
The Twins are struck by lightning.
The Twins fall into the Void.
